scripts.clean-all: npm run clean-app && npm run clean-lib && npm run clean-tests
scripts.install-all: npm run install-lib && npm run install-tests && npm run install-app
scripts.install-app: cd app && npm install && npm link wgsg-lib
scripts.install-lib: cd lib && npm install && npm link
scripts.install-tests: cd tests && npm install && npm link wgsg-lib
scripts.reinstall-all: npm run clean-all && npm run install-all
